plugin_sdk_settings.url.description: HTTP storage: the URL of the CSV server. Local storage: the path to the CSV file or directory.

fields.label: Storage Location
fields.description: Where the CSV is read from: over HTTP, or from the local file system.

fields.label: Custom query parameters
fields.description: Query parameters added to every HTTP request. HTTP storage only.

instructions.msg: Set jsonData.storage to 'http' (default) or 'local'. The root url is the server URL for http and the file path for local. Authentication, TLS and headers apply to http only. Local mode is disabled by default: it requires `[plugin.marcusolsson-csv-datasource] allow_local_mode = true` in Grafana's configuration, otherwise requests fail with 'local mode has been disabled by your administrator' even with a valid path. Local mode is not available in Grafana Cloud.
